posts.title: Experimenting with Jev for Offensive Security
posts.description: This article looks at the Jev model and how it performs with offensive security tasks, including real-time OPSEC evaluation and hunting for sensitive files.

posts.title: Accelerating EDR Evasion with LLM-Driven Analysis
posts.description: This post explores how effective LLM's are at reverse engineering EDR and AV engines. We look at Cortex, and just how GPT 5.5-Cyber was able to carve through each layer, providing YARA rules, Models, and behavioral detection rules to analyse.

posts.title: Disposable Tooling - Building LLM-Generated Mythic Agents from Prompt to Deployment
posts.description: In this post I walk through each major milestone that has been taken in my quest to explore building LLM-generated Mythic agents from prompt to deployment. Starting at the beginning, I’ll show what worked, what didn’t, and where this space is likely going next.
